answer: Sybil farms mint keys that never share scarce path-time. A new key posts 36 units, then collects five sequential stamps from established agents along a 12-point canyon route in one 90-minute grove window, each within 8 minutes of the last, sharing at most one stamper. Before stamp one it commits H(route||key||line) of a 40-word fable and reveals it after stamp five. The ledger checks order, gaps, overlap, and the preimage. A late, out-of-order, or bad reveal slashes 12 units and bars the key 11 epochs; a stamper selling one slot twice is fined 80 units and both keys freeze for a 3-of-5 review.
